title: 軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統
titleEn: Rail Wheel Contact Friction Management and Lubrication
summary: 軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統以「輪緣與軌頂摩擦位置管理及黏著取捨」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。輪緣潤滑與軌頂摩擦調節作用位置及目標不同，減少磨耗不能以犧牲牽引制動黏著為代價，需同時追蹤摩擦、磨耗與材料散布。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops location-specific flange and railhead friction management through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Flange lubrication and top-of-rail friction management act at different locations with different aims; wear reduction must be evaluated alongside traction/braking adhesion and material carryover. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN; y=mu*N=25 kN. Increasing only mu with a ten-percent increase gives y=27.5 kN. Boundary: Simplified Coulomb ceiling; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=20 m/s, mu=0.15 1, g=9.81 m/s2; y=v**2/(2*mu*g)=135.916 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=164.458 m. Boundary: Level track with constant friction and no build-up delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 黏著牽引上限與制動黏著距離
stages.titleEn: Adhesion traction ceiling & Adhesion-limited braking scale
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「黏著牽引上限」與「制動黏著距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Adhesion traction ceiling" and "Adhesion-limited braking scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 黏著牽引上限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adhesion traction ceiling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏著牽引上限」如何影響軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adhesion traction ceiling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail Wheel Contact Friction Management and Lubrication”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 摩擦係數與法向力限制可傳遞切向力。本模型把 mu 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 27.5 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。簡化庫侖上限。使用切向力及法向力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏著牽引上限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Friction coefficient and normal force limit transferable tangential force. In this model, mu is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 27.5 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Simplified Coulomb ceiling. Use tangential and normal force as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Excess lubrication may reduce available traction; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adhesion traction ceiling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN; y=mu*N=25 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏著牽引上限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adhesion traction ceiling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN；y=mu*N=25 kN。只把 mu 增加百分之十，y=27.5 kN。模型邊界：簡化庫侖上限；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN; y=mu*N=25 kN. Increasing only mu with a ten-percent increase gives y=27.5 kN. Boundary: Simplified Coulomb ceiling; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以切向力及法向力區分模型與觀察，先用低載摩擦滑台與荷重元建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use tangential and normal force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 黏著牽引上限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Adhesion traction ceiling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「黏著牽引上限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adhesion traction ceiling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以切向力及法向力區分模型與觀察，先用低載摩擦滑台與荷重元建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「黏著牽引上限」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use tangential and normal force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load friction sled and load cells, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Adhesion traction ceiling. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「黏著牽引上限」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出簡化庫侖上限如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力造成偏離的合成觀察，以切向力及法向力說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Adhesion traction ceiling, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Simplified Coulomb ceiling. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction. Explain which evidence in tangential and normal force distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 黏著牽引上限：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「黏著牽引上限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Adhesion traction ceiling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力。這個失效與「黏著牽引上限」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查切向力及法向力，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction. This failure and a measurement bias in Adhesion traction ceiling can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check tangential and normal force rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. steps.title: 簡化阿查德磨耗：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 本單元以體積損失與載入距離區分模型與觀察，先用低載試片輪廓與質量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「簡化阿查德磨耗」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
